detection_rules.name: SQL Injection — Union Based Extraction
detection_rules.description: Adversary uses UNION operator to append database query results to legitimate application output.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Enforce parameterized queries (PreparedStatements) and strict input validation on all parameters.

detection_rules.name: SQL Injection — Boolean / Tautology Bypass
detection_rules.description: Adversary injects boolean tautology (e.g. OR 1=1) into WHERE clause to bypass authentication or extract records.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Refactor SQL queries into ORM parameterized calls and implement WAF SQLi inspection rules.

detection_rules.name: SQL Injection — Comment Delimiter / Blind Probe
detection_rules.description: Adversary injects SQL inline comments or time delay functions to conduct blind timing attacks.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Block raw SQL comments and enforce strict parameter typing across the web tier.

detection_rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting — Script Tag Injection
detection_rules.description: Direct injection of executable JavaScript tags into HTTP request parameters.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Contextual HTML entity encoding and Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers.

detection_rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting — DOM Event Handler Attribute
detection_rules.description: Adversary injects HTML elements with weaponized event handlers to execute arbitrary JavaScript.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Sanitize user HTML inputs via DOMPurify and restrict inline scripts with CSP nonces.

detection_rules.name: OS Command Injection — Shell Metacharacters
detection_rules.mitreName: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
detection_rules.description: Execution of arbitrary system shell commands via unvalidated application input parameters.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Avoid invoking system shell processes; use native language libraries with hardened argument arrays.

detection_rules.name: Directory Traversal / Local File Inclusion (LFI)
detection_rules.description: Path manipulation attempting to traverse outside document root to access sensitive operating system files.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Whitelist allowed filenames, sanitize path characters, and resolve realpath within chroot boundaries.

detection_rules.name: Malicious Web Shell File Upload
detection_rules.description: Attempt to upload executable server-side scripts (e.g. PHP shells) to gain persistent code execution.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Enforce strict MIME validation, re-encode image files, and store uploads on noexec storage.

detection_rules.name: Automated Security Scanner Probe
detection_rules.description: Automated tool signatures recognized scanning endpoints for exploitable flaws.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Rate-limit probing IPs and configure WAF to automatically drop known scanner signatures.

detection_rules.name: Authentication Brute Force Abuse
detection_rules.description: Multiple failed authentication events exceeding threshold in short succession.
detection_rules.recommendedMitigation: Enforce account lockout policies, CAPTCHA after 3 failures, and IP jailing via Fail2ban.
